data.name: Fahlaan
data.gender_notes: Fahlaan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is easy to please, or the one who has a simple and uncomplicated nature. The name Fahlaan carries the meaning “Easy, Simple” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fahlaan usually hope their child will grow to embody easy, simple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the simplicity and ease in one's spiritual journey towards Allah.
data.etymology: Fahlaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Easy, Simple.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fahlaan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فاهلان
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الفعل فهل و معناه من يفهم و يدرك
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاهلان مشتق من الفعل فهل و معناه من يفهم و يدرك، و هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الفهم و الإدراك، و يدل على الشخص الذي يتميز بالذكاء و الفهم السريع، و هو من الأسماء المحببة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: فاہلان
in_urdu.meaning: فاہلان نام کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار اور عقلمند شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاہلان نام کا مطلب ہے سمجھدار اور عقلمند شخص، یہ نام عربی زبان کے فعل فهل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا اور ادراک کرنا، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا تعلق ذہانت اور فہم سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फाहलान
in_hindi.meaning: फाहलान नाम का अर्थ है समझदार और बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाहलान नाम का अर्थ है समझदार और बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति, यह नाम अरबी भाषा के क्रिया फहल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समझना और जानना, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में लोकप्रिय है और इसका संबंध बुद्धिमत्ता और समझ से है।

in_pashto.name: فاهلان
in_pashto.meaning: فاهلان د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې معنی يې ده هوښيار او دانا سړی
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاهلان د پښتو ژبې يو نوم دی چې معنی يې ده هوښيار او دانا سړی، دا نوم د عربي ژبې د فعل فهل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې ده پوهیدل او فهم کول، دا نوم په پښتو ثقافت کې کارول کیږي او د پوهې او فهم سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Fahlaan
in_english.meaning: Fahlaan means intelligent and perceptive person

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Fahlaan" signifies a person who is content and easy to please. This is a desirable trait in Islamic culture as it encourages basic human values of forgiveness, understanding, and contentment. It is often said that a truly pious person is one who takes pleasure in the blessings bestowed upon them by God, rather than craving for more. As such, the name "Fahlaan" can serve as a reminder to be grateful for the simple things in life and to seek peace and happiness within ourselves and our relationships.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Fahlaan" has deeper symbolism. It is a reminder to seek inner fulfillment and contentment, rather than relying on external sources for happiness. This aligns with the teachings of Islam, which encourage the pursuit of inner peace and a strong connection with God. By embodying the qualities of Fahlaan, one can develop a deeper spiritual practice and cultivate a stronger relationship with the divine. Furthermore, being easy to please and having a simple nature can help one navigate the complexities of life with grace and resilience, allowing for a more peaceful and fulfilling spiritual journey.
